scope: Initial CAD proposal-region annotations; not physical grasp labels or paper-provided NIST regions

BNC_Male.label: BNC barrel side band
BNC_Male.reviewed_geometry_basis: Outward barrel side faces between measured axial shoulders at Z -2.495003 mm and +3.085 mm; excludes mating end and narrow rear stem.

DSUB_Male.label: Central DSUB housing side walls
DSUB_Male.reviewed_geometry_basis: Measured central housing walls at X +/-20 mm, Y +/-8 mm; rear end Z -21.8 mm and mating shoulder Z 15.200002 mm. Excludes side fastening wings and contact insert.

Gear_Large.label: Gear external flanks and hub sides
Gear_Large.reviewed_geometry_basis: Main gear component 0 only; separate set screw component excluded. Outward radial faces exclude axial caps; bore and seating labels remain excluded.

KET12_Square_12mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
KET12_Square_12mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

KET16_Square_16mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
KET16_Square_16mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

KET8_Square_8mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
KET8_Square_8mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

M16_Hex_Nut.label: Nut external flats and outward bevels
M16_Hex_Nut.reviewed_geometry_basis: Main nut component outward radial faces; inward thread/bore walls and seating surface remain excluded. This does not validate threading.

RGOCG12-50_12mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
RGOCG12-50_12mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

RGOCG16-50_16mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
RGOCG16-50_16mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

RGOCG8-50_8mm.label: Exposed outward shaft sides
RGOCG8-50_8mm.reviewed_geometry_basis: Longitudinal CAD shaft axis; final 20 mm inserted segment is excluded separately by the protected region.

USB_Male.label: USB connector housing sides; cable excluded
USB_Male.reviewed_geometry_basis: Connected component 0 is the connector housing; component 5 is the separate long cable. Plug/contact components 1-4 and the mating halfspace are excluded.

Waterproof_Male.label: Central waterproof housing side walls
Waterproof_Male.reviewed_geometry_basis: Measured central housing walls at X +/-21.6 mm and Y +/-16.25 mm, between rear end Z -17.700002 mm and mating shoulder Z 1.799999 mm. Excludes outboard retaining features.
